how_to_use: Engine implements every 'core' op generically. 'bespoke' ops are used by one or two items: implement them as a named hook on that item, or until then hand the item's text to the Narrator. Any op the engine doesn't recognise must fall back to the Narrator, never be silently ignored.

items.summary: Add to a derived stat (hp, ap, move, armor, init, mp_max, ...).
Not automatable: the Narrator (AI or human) decides using the item's text.

example.note: Pick the opposite of exotic buffs.
